Recorded claim:
Follow the read-dialog pattern: import `PositionedDialog` from `mail/components/calendar/content/positioned-dialog.mjs`, declare `CalendarEventCreateEditDialog extends PositionedDialog`, include the template through `calendar.inc.xhtml`, register the module in `mail/components/calendar/moz.build`, localize the accessible name in `calendarDialog.ftl`, and register the browser test in `browser.toml`. [Task 1]
